context: Hiroshi-boss and Kenji discuss a representative attending a trade event.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 国際の展示会、代表を送りたい。
lines.en: I'd like to send a representative to the international expo.
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm professional delivery carefully

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええですね、誰が行きますか?
lines.style: soft Kansai man voice, warm engaged delivery carefully

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 若手及びベテラン、両方、参加させたい。
lines.en: I want both young and veteran staff to attend.
lines.style: professional boss voice, soft warm strategic delivery carefully

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 製品の使用例も、見せられますね。
lines.en: We can show product use cases too.
lines.style: gentle Kansai man voice, soft warm professional delivery carefully

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: その点について、準備を進めてくれ。
lines.en: Please proceed with preparations on that point.
lines.style: warm boss voice, soft warm directive delivery carefully

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 了解しました、頑張ります。
lines.style: soft Kansai man voice, warm committed delivery carefully

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: warm boss voice, soft warm trusting delivery carefully
